# REGULEX Legal Consultancy

> REGULEX is a boutique legal consultancy based in the UAE, specializing in corporate law, international arbitration, commercial contracts, and cross-border structuring for businesses operating across the UAE and MENA region.

## About

REGULEX Legal Consultancy (REGULEX FZ-LLC) is led by Oleg Pikalov, a legal professional with 11+ years of experience across corporate law, international arbitration, M&A, and commercial contracts. The firm serves businesses, investors, and private clients navigating legal matters in the UAE Mainland, ADGM, DIFC, and cross-border MENA jurisdictions.

## Services

- **Corporate Law**: Company formation, corporate governance, shareholder agreements, restructuring, M&A transactions across UAE Mainland, ADGM, and DIFC
- **International Arbitration**: Representation in LCIA, DIAC, and ad hoc arbitrations; multi-million dollar dispute resolution; arbitration clause drafting
- **Commercial Law**: Contract drafting and review, supply agreements, distribution and agency agreements, joint ventures, licensing
- **Legal Drafting**: Bespoke legal document creation, template libraries, regulatory compliance documentation
- **Structuring & Private Clients**: Business structuring, holding company setup, family office advisory, wealth planning, succession planning
- **Legal Services Subscription**: Monthly retainer-based legal coverage for startups and scaling businesses — Head of Legal as a service

## Jurisdictions

- UAE Mainland (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, other emirates)
- ADGM (Abu Dhabi Global Market)
- DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre)
- Cross-border MENA
